key_claims.claim: The 2026 FIFA World Cup (Jun 11 – Jul 19) is in its group stage as of Jun 21, with 48 teams across 16 groups of 3
Without real-time match data from Jun 11–21, specific next-round predictions cannot be reliably made; pre-tournament FIFA rankings provide only a baseline prior
Traditional powerhouses (Argentina, France, Brazil, England, Spain, Germany) enter as favorites based on pre-tournament form and squad depth
The expanded 48-team format introduces higher upset probability in group stage due to single-match variance in 3-team groups

gaps.description: No real-time match results from June 11–21, 2026 are available. All analysis relies on pre-tournament data frozen at January 2026 cutoff.
Player injuries, squad changes, and tactical adjustments made after January 2026 are unknown.
In-match performance data (xG, possession, passing networks) from already-played group matches is unavailable.

source_notes.notes: Tournament structure, qualified teams, schedule framework confirmed pre-Jan 2026.
Last ranking snapshot before Jan 2026. Does not reflect pre-tournament friendlies or camp form.

t0.narrative: 截至2026年6月21日，2026美加墨世界杯已进行约10天，处于小组赛阶段。48队16组3队的赛制使单场方差极大，传统强队（阿根廷、法国、巴西、英格兰）虽为纸面热门，但缺乏6月11日以来的实时赛果，任何具体预测置信度均低。需先接入实时数据源（FIFA API、Opta、ESPN）获取当前积分榜、xG数据及伤病报告后再生成定向预测。

sections.title: Tournament State (~Jun 21, 2026)
sections.summary: Approximately 10 days into the group stage. 48 teams, 16 groups of 3, each team plays 2 group matches. Most teams have played 1 match by now.
bullets: 48 teams, 16 groups of 3, top 2 advance (32 to knockout)
Knockout path: R32 → R16 → QF → SF → Final

sections.title: Pre-Tournament Favorite Tiering
sections.summary: Based on pre-tournament FIFA rankings, recent major tournament performance, and squad depth.
bullets: Tier 3 (dark horses): Uruguay, Morocco, Japan, USA

sections.title: Format-Driven Volatility
sections.summary: The 3-team group format introduces structural unpredictability.
bullets: 2 group matches per team — single loss can eliminate a favorite
No simultaneous final matchday; fairness concerns
Possible penalty shootouts in group stage
Expanded 32-team knockout means more R32 mismatches

sections.title: Prediction Framework (requires live data)
sections.summary: When live data is available, apply this framework for next-round predictions.
bullets: Input: xG differential, conversion rate, defensive metrics from played matches
Input: rest days and travel distance
Output: per-match W/D/L probabilities with key driver narratives
